entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives network indications and determines its operational mode based on network support and UE capabilities.

entities.name: Interworking without N26 interface not supported
entities.description: Network indication that interworking without N26 interface is not supported, received by the UE.

entities.name: Interworking without N26 interface supported
entities.description: Network indication that interworking without N26 interface is supported, received by the UE.

entities.name: UE does not support dual-registration mode
entities.description: Condition where the UE lacks support for dual-registration mode.

entities.name: UE determines to operate in single-registration mode
entities.description: Condition where a UE supporting dual-registration mode chooses to operate in single-registration mode.

entities.name: Operation as per subclause 4.8.2.2
entities.description: UE operational procedure defined in subclause 4.8.2.2, triggered when interworking without N26 interface is not supported.

entities.name: Operation as per subclause 4.8.2.3
entities.description: UE operational procedure defined in subclause 4.8.2.3, triggered when interworking without N26 interface is supported and UE operates in single-registration mode.

relations.description: Receipt of 'interworking without N26 interface not supported' indication causes the UE to operate as described in subclause 4.8.2.2.
The 'interworking without N26 interface supported' indication is guarded by the condition that the UE does not support dual-registration mode.
The 'interworking without N26 interface supported' indication is guarded by the condition that the UE determines to operate in single-registration mode.
If the UE does not support dual-registration mode, it operates as described in subclause 4.8.2.3.
If the UE determines to operate in single-registration mode, it operates as described in subclause 4.8.2.3.
